استحلا (form X)
# اِسْتَحَلَّا (istaḥallā) /is.ta.ħal.laː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِسْتَحَلَّ (istaḥalla)
# اِسْتَحِلَّا (istaḥillā) /is.ta.ħil.laː/: second-person dual imperative of اِسْتَحَلَّ (istaḥalla)
